Sajjan Singh Yadav takes over as J&K’s 34th CS Listen to this article 0.75x 1x 1.5x 00:00 / 00:00 Jammu, Nov 18: Senior Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of AGMUT cadre Sajjan Singh Yadav took over as the 34th Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir at the Civil Secretariat, Jammu on Wednesday, November 18, 2026.
 Advertisment He succeeded Atal Dulloo, the 1989 batch IAS officer,   who attained superannuation on October 31, 2026.
 Yadav was transferred from Delhi to J&K and posted as the successor to Dulloo by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) on October 24, 2026.
 As per MHA order, his posting as the new Chief Secretary of J&K was to take effect from November 1, 2026, exactly a day after his predecessor's superannuation or from the date of joining, whichever is later.
 Advertisment Reports quoting anonymous official sources suggested that Yadav could not assume his new charge in J&K immediately (on November 1, 2026) as Delhi government had requested to the Centre to allow it (Delhi) to retain him till November 16, in the wake of his crucial engagements as Additional Chief Secretary in the Delhi government and CEO Delhi Jal Board during the festive season.
 Until Sajjan Singh Yadav formally took over as the Chief Secretary of J&K on Wednesday, another senior IAS officer Shailendra Kumar held the additional charge of the post.
 Sharing this information, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations, J&K on ‘X’ posted, “Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav, a 1995 batch IAS officer, today assumed charge as the Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir at the Civil Secretariat, Jammu, following his transfer and appointment by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs. Bringing over three decades of administrative experience across public administration, financial management, health, nutrition, and development policy, he was welcomed by senior administrative secretaries and other officers upon assuming the Union Territory’s highest administrative office.”
 Advertisment Born on January 5, 1969 in Haryana, Yadav holds a Bachelor of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry degree from Hisar University.
 He is an author and public commentator with books including “Scaling Mountain UPSC: Inspiring Stories of Young IAS Officers” published in English, Hindi, Marathi and “India’s Vaccine Growth Story: From Cowpox to Vaccine Maitri”, translated in 15 Indian languages, to his credit.
 A doctor of Public Health from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, he did his MBA from University of Delhi and MPA from the Humphrey Institute of Public Affairs at the University of Minnesota.
 In his distinguished career graph, Yadav served at key positions in the Government of India including the Special Secretary in the Ministry of Finance; Joint Secretary in the Ministry of Expenditure; Joint Secretary and Mission Director of POSHAN Abhiyan under the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
 He also held the positions of Advisor to the Administrator of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu; Commissioner of VAT; Commissioner of Food and Supplies in Delhi and Commissioner of the East Delhi Municipal Corporation.
